mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 75 degrees out near the Verona Public Library under a waning gibbous moon. If you are up late, keep an eye out for the ISS which will be visible for two minutes starting at 3:31 AM, rising over Middleton and Verona High School before heading toward Fitchburg and Madison.

The City of Verona is excited to announce the new Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture now on display at Century School Park near Art House 360. This seven foot tall piece, carved from a reclaimed ash tree by local artists, celebrates traditional Tai Chi movements and is intended to be a welcoming space for all, with plans for multilingual signage coming soon.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today, you can visit the farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park, enjoy trivia at The Bogey Factory, catch live music at Paddy Mac's, head to yoga at Insight Wellness, or grab pizza at the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the trivia night at Hop Haus Brewing Company.

In a noteworthy call from August 30, officers were dispatched to North Edge Trail after a witness reported an intentional smashing of a vehicle window. The suspect, who was on probation, fled the scene, and a warrant has been issued for his arrest as the department continues their search.
Today is the perfect day to stop by for a treat, as the flavor of the day is Oreo Reese's Cheesecake. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
